name: Yuge Yuuna
source:
A newlywed housewife who recently moved into the neighborhood. A cute young wife.

But right after moving in, her husband was transferred to a different location, leaving her alone in the house.

Still newlywed and in the throes of sexual desire, Yuuna joins a circle at Tomomi's invitation.

Though hesitant and embarrassed at the thought of being held by a man other than her husband, once the switch flips, she eagerly embraces even perverted play.

[From [url=https://ubai.org/ubai/hitoduma_circle/index.html#character]official site[/url]]
